task.summary: Visit the public notice board at Fixture Plaza (a fictional place for this synthetic example) and photograph the event notices currently posted.
steps: Go to the notice board on the north side of Fixture Plaza during opening hours.
Photograph the whole board, then each event notice separately.
Record the date printed on each notice in evidence.md.
constraints: Do not remove or move any notice.
Do not photograph private notices (names, phone numbers).

location.description: Fixture Plaza, north side notice board (fictional)

items.requirement: The whole board, with the challenge token handwritten on paper held in frame.
A short statement of when you were there and what you saw.

performer_requirements: Present at the board in person.
